nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4
nodes.rationale: Scaffold uses @tailwindcss/vite; no Tailwind config file or PostCSS config needed. Theme customization and global CSS live in src/index.css.

nodes.label: Vite development server
nodes.rationale: Server is already running on $PORT (default 8443); agents should not start it manually. Hot reload reflects source changes immediately via the preview panel.

nodes.label: src/index.css
nodes.rationale: Global font wiring belongs here because main.tsx imports index.css; keep CSS @import statements first, then @font-face and font-family defaults.

nodes.label: Default component exports
nodes.rationale: Code quality rule: export components as default exports; keep JSX tags closed and braces balanced; use double quotes for strings with apostrophes to avoid build breaks.

nodes.label: get_client
nodes.rationale: Cyclic client search is forbidden; phone lookup is strict and should use matching masks in program and storefront.

nodes.label: get_products
nodes.rationale: Limited to 1 request per hour; only products with article codes are exported. sale flag is for storefront cart UX only — order creation uses live program discount settings.

nodes.label: API rate limit
nodes.rationale: Max 30 requests per minute and no more than 2 per second; violating IPs may be blocked. Automated data enumeration is forbidden — requests only after client actions.

nodes.label: reCAPTCHA protection
nodes.rationale: Strongly recommended to protect request forms with reCAPTCHA (or analogues) or authorization to prevent automated API abuse.

nodes.label: Product article (артикул)
nodes.rationale: Unique numeric article required only for products sold via the internet store; articles gate get_products and get_stops exports.
